status: Recorded before this rerun. Development extension of the frozen corrected reference; not a replacement primary or an independent confirmation.
rules: Inherit the frozen primary preprocessing, policy source/variation gates, alpha grid, complete-target chronological tuning, minimum histories and full allocation settings. Apply training-only imputation, 1st/99th percentile clipping and scaling to added inputs too. Tune each asset and candidate separately using the unchanged grid. Rebuild each candidate's past-error variance and continuous portfolio from its own forecasts, including warm-up. No return-based threshold or feature search.
eligibility: Require identical baseline and added-input eligibility throughout training and forecast history; abort if this dataset cannot support that comparison. Match all forecast and allocated decision dates across candidates and historical mean; never silently trim away primary dates.
reproduction: Rerun the corrected baseline and require forecasts, alpha choices, allocations, error variances and costs to reproduce the frozen saved run within 1e-10 before reporting extensions.
evaluation: All matched forecast dates including warm-up, then common allocated dates. Report per-asset MAE, RMSE, OOS R2 against matched historical mean and change versus corrected baseline; largest absolute forecasts and 20% flags. Then net return, daily drawdown, turnover, costs, weight-limit frequency, calendar years, episodes and rolling 12-month windows. Reuse previously recorded block-bootstrap settings without retuning. No automatic winner selection.
preservation: Write separate corrected_signals_* artifacts. Preserve primary freeze/spec/code and original signal results. Revised histories and assumed availability lags remain limitations.
